body: New packages/simulation/arena_ai_bridge.h/.c extends gpt2-alpine-c's GAME_AI_NORTHSTAR.md state-serializer/action-decoder pattern to arena's hero/ability state. arena_serialize_state() writes a stable self/foe state string; arena_decode_action() parses move+cast tokens, failing closed on garbage. 7 new tests, all green alongside full existing suite. Contract only -- not wired into the live bot or :8088 inference server yet, which need external Colab GPU + human trigger. Commit 93160da. BACKLOG S170-36.
